question: Who won the Arjuna Award for Para Swimming at the National Sports Awards, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suyash Jadhav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Para Swimmer Suyash Jadhav received Arjuna Award on 29 August 2020.**
 
• He belongs to the** Karmala District of Maharashtra**.
 
• He is the only Indian Para swimmer to have achieved the** ‘A’ qualifying mark for the 2016 Paralympics held in Rio de Janeiro.**
 
• Jadhav also won **a silver and a bronze medal at the 2015 IWAS World Games in Sochi, Russia,** conducted by the International Wheelchair and Amputee Sports Federation.
